title: Punjab Plans to Hire Retired and Private Doctors
excerpt: The Punjab government plans to appoint retired doctors and private medical professionals as professors and associate professors.
body_html:
The government of Punjab is making plans to bring in experienced medical professionals for academic roles. According to recent reports, the administration intends to appoint retired doctors alongside medical experts from the private sector.

Under this initiative, these professionals will take on positions as professors and associate professors. The move is aimed at utilizing the expertise of seasoned practitioners within medical institutions.
